sentences.text: Benjamin Hammond Haggerty -LRB- born June 19 , 1983 -RRB- , known by his stage name Macklemore -LRB- -LSB- ˈmæk.ləmɔr -RSB- -RRB- and formerly Professor Mack Lemore , is an American hip hop recording artist from Kent , Washington .	hip hop	Hip hop music
His stage name originated from his childhood ; it was the name of his made-up superhero .
Since 2000 , he has independently released one mixtape , three EPs , and four albums .	mixtape	mixtape
He has significantly collaborated with producer Ryan Lewis as Macklemore & Ryan Lewis .	Macklemore & Ryan Lewis	Macklemore & Ryan Lewis	Ryan Lewis	Ryan Lewis
Macklemore and Ryan Lewis 's single `` Thrift Shop '' reached number one on the U.S. Billboard Hot 100 in 2013 .	Ryan Lewis	Ryan Lewis	Thrift Shop	Thrift Shop	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

The single was soon dubbed by Billboard as the first song since 1994 to top the Hot 100 chart without the support of a major record label , although Macklemore , in a slightly unusual recording contract , pays a nominal percentage of sales to use Warner Bros. .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)	recording contract	recording contract
Records 's radio promotion department to push his singles .

Their second single , `` Ca n't Hold Us '' , also peaked at number one of the Hot 100 Chart , making Macklemore and Lewis the first duo in the chart 's history to have their first two singles both reach the peak position .
Macklemore and Lewis released their debut studio album The Heist on October 9 , 2012 , which charted at number 2 on the U.S. Billboard 200 .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)	The Heist	The Heist (album)

The pair won four Grammy Awards at the 2014 ceremony , including Best New Artist , Best Rap Album -LRB- The Heist -RRB- , Best Rap Song and Best Rap Performance -LRB- `` Thrift Shop '' -RRB- .
